topics.name: Prepositions of time, place and movement
Conjunctions (but, so, because, although, when, while)

options: Kareena got an medal and a certificate.
Kareena got a medal and an certificate.
Kareena got a medal and a certificate.
questions.rule: Medal and certificate begin with consonant sounds, so use a.

options: The award consists of a medal, a plaque and a certificate.
The award consist of a medal, a plaque and a certificate.
The award consisting of a medal, a plaque and a certificate.
questions.rule: The award is singular, so the verb takes -s: consists.

options: The function was held in Thursday.
The function was held on Thursday.
The function was held at Thursday.
questions.rule: Use on with days and dates: on Thursday.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Brave begins with a consonant sound, so use a.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Kareena is one person (he/she), so the present verb is lives.
A full date takes on: on 15 May 2024.
LPG is read 'el-pee-jee', which starts with a vowel sound, so use an.
A goes before the singular noun bucket: She threw a bucket of water.

chat: When did Kareena get the award?
questions.rule: Use in with months and years: in December 2024.

chat: Does your father read the newspaper every day?
options: Yes, he do read it every morning.
Yes, he reads it every morning.
Yes, he reading it every morning.
questions.rule: With he in the simple present, the verb takes -s: he reads.

options: Although the smoke was thick, but she kept throwing water.
Although the smoke was thick, she kept throwing water.
Although the smoke was thick, she keep throwing water.
questions.rule: Although already joins the two parts, so don't add but.

options: The President gave her a award.
The President gave her the award.
questions.rule: There is only one President of India, so say the President; award needs an or the.

options: Veer Bal Din is observed in 26 December.
Veer Bal Din is observed at 26 December.
Veer Bal Din is observed on 26 December.
questions.rule: A particular date takes on: on 26 December.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Children is plural, so use were.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Despite is followed by a noun, not a clause. Before 'she was afraid' use Although.
Every child is singular, so use was.
Use for with a length of time (many years) and since with a starting point (2015).
My sister is singular, so the verb is watches.

chat: Why did Kareena get the award?
options: She got it because of she saved seventy families.
She got it because she save seventy families.
She got it because she saved seventy families.
questions.rule: Because is followed by a clause: because she saved ... ('because of' needs a noun).

chat: What time does the news come on TV?
options: It comes on in eight o'clock.
It comes on at eight o'clock.
It comes on on eight o'clock.
questions.rule: Use at with clock times: at eight o'clock.

options: One of the children was from Amravati.
One of the children were from Amravati.
One of the child was from Amravati.
questions.rule: The subject is one, so use was; after one of the the noun is plural: children.

options: Kareena is an honest and brave girl.
Kareena is a honest and brave girl.
Kareena is an honest and brave girls.
questions.rule: Honest starts with a silent h (a vowel sound), so use an.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: With a named day, even with 'morning', use on: on Thursday morning.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: A superlative (bravest) takes the: one of the bravest children.

questions.after: the fire was spreading, Kareena kept throwing buckets of water.
questions.rule: While joins two actions happening together. During and despite need a noun, not a clause.
News looks plural but is uncountable and singular: the news was.
So joins a cause to its result: the door was locked, so she broke in.
Use at with clock times: the ceremony began at ten o'clock.

chat: What did the award consist of?
options: It had a medal, a plaque and a certificate.
It had a medal, an plaque and a certificate.
It had a medal, a plaque and certificate.
questions.rule: Each singular countable noun needs a: a medal, a plaque and a certificate.

chat: Did you finish your homework before dinner?
options: Yes, I finished it while you cooking.
Yes, I finished it while you were cooking.
Yes, I finished it during you were cooking.
questions.rule: While + a full clause (you were cooking); during needs a noun.

options: Kareena and her mother were invited to Delhi.
Kareena and her mother was invited to Delhi.
Kareena and her mother were invite to Delhi.
questions.rule: Two people joined by and make a plural subject: were invited.

options: The children received medals and certificates.
The childrens received medals and certificates.
The children received medals and an certificates.
questions.rule: Children is already plural; plural nouns take no a/an.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Not a single child is singular, so use was.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Parts of the day take in: in the morning. Use on for days and dates.

questions.after: honour for the whole city of Amravati.
questions.rule: Honour begins with a silent h, so it has a vowel sound: an honour.
But joins two contrasting clauses. Despite and because of need a noun, not a clause.
Singular subject: Does + subject + base verb (include).
Act starts with a vowel sound, so use an.

chat: How long have you lived in Amravati?
questions.rule: A starting point in time (2015) takes since.

chat: Which award do brave children get?
options: Brave children gets the Bal Puraskar.
Brave children getting the Bal Puraskar.
Brave children get the Bal Puraskar.
questions.rule: Children is plural, so the verb has no -s: get.

options: Each of the seventeen children were honoured with a medal, a plaque and a certificate.
Each of the seventeen children was honoured with a medal, a plaque and a certificate.
Each of the seventeen child was honoured with a medal, a plaque and a certificate.
questions.rule: Each of + plural noun takes a singular verb: each ... was.

options: Although the flat was full of smoke, but Kareena went inside and pulled out the cylinder.
Despite the flat was full of smoke, Kareena went inside and pulled out the cylinder.
Although the flat was full of smoke, Kareena went inside and pulled out the cylinder.
questions.rule: Although + clause, with no but. Despite cannot be followed by a clause.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: We say on the occasion of.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: News is uncountable, so it never takes a. Use the news.

questions.before: The number of children who received awards this year
questions.rule: The number of ... is singular, so use was.

questions.after: Kareena heard people shouting about the fire, she rushed upstairs with a bucket of water.
questions.rule: When joins a clause of time. During and despite must be followed by a noun.
Although + clause, comma, then the main clause.
When who is the subject, it takes a singular verb: Who presents ...?

chat: I read about Kareena in the newspaper.
options: She put out a fire and pulled an LPG cylinder out of a burning flat.
She put out a fire and pulled a LPG cylinder out of a burning flat.
She put out a fire and pulled an LPG cylinder out of an burning flat.
questions.rule: Choose a/an by sound: an LPG ('el'), a burning flat.

chat: Where and when was the award ceremony held?
options: It was held at Rashtrapati Bhavan in 26 December 2024.
It was held at Rashtrapati Bhavan on 26 December 2024.
It was held on Rashtrapati Bhavan on 26 December 2024.
questions.rule: At a building or place, on a date.
